data.title: Grid
data.tagline: Plan rows and columns as one layout system
data.description: CSS Grid controls two-dimensional layouts where rows and columns work together. It suits galleries, dashboards, and page regions. Let columns adapt to available space instead of copying one fixed desktop grid onto every screen.

use: Page regions with aligned rows and columns
avoid: Use grid for a simple one-dimensional row
Hard-code many columns on small screens
Reorder content visually in a way that breaks reading order
Create empty tracks only to imitate spacing

lessonPractice.title: A template library needs multiple rows and columns of similar cards, with fewer columns as the container narrows. Which implementation fits?

options.label: Give each card a fixed width and margin and calculate every wrap point
options.feedback: Manual calculations bind the layout to the current count and width, causing gaps or overflow when the container changes.

options.label: Use Grid on the parent and define responsive tracks with minmax
options.feedback: The task coordinates rows and columns. Grid tracks manage width, gaps, and rearrangement from the available space.

options.label: Wrap with Flex and fix every card at 33.33% width
options.feedback: Flex can wrap, but fixed thirds still require gap calculations and separate rules for narrower column counts.

data.agentPrompt: Turn the template cards into a responsive Grid using a readable minimum width, minmax, and a shared gap. Do not fix cards to three equal columns. Verify wide, tablet, and mobile widths for overflow and visible card actions.

references.title: A Complete Guide to CSS Grid Layout
